issues.reason: *Names and casing* states "Inflection only — never derivation" (coastal is not coast), and the noun "urgency" is a derivation of the adjective, so classing the referent `urgent` collapses a pair the rule forbids collapsing.

A deadjectival quality nominal is genuinely outside the of-phrase rules (no underlying verb, not a relational noun), and attaching the bearer to a reified state by Experiencer is the licensed reified-state shape of *Complements of nouns and adjectives* with nothing false or ill-typed emitted, so the calibration line makes it acceptable improvisation rather than a defect.

Coreference is symbol reuse for mentions that refer to the same thing, and "this" and "this request" are one referent, so reusing sk_request_1 asserts nothing false; the backward-looking wording of *Coreference & anaphora* leaves cataphora uncovered, which is not a licence to mint a second symbol for one referent.

gaps_confirmed: A deadjectival quality nominal used as an argument ("the urgency of this"): the of-phrase rules cover act/result nominalizations with an underlying verb and true relational nouns, neither of which fits.
First-person (speaker) reference "I": the pronoun rule enumerates he/she/it/they and supplies no class or symbol for a speaker or addressee.
A bare direct quotation with no attributing clause: there is no licensed frame for "this was said", so the quoted utterance can only be translated as if asserted.
new_gaps: Cataphora — a pronoun or demonstrative whose antecedent appears only in a later clause; *Coreference & anaphora* resolves anaphors to already-introduced antecedents only.
repair_summary: Retyped the object of "see" from the derived adjective class `urgent` to the surface noun class `urgency`, renaming the witness sk_urgent_1 to sk_urgency_1 to match its class; no other atom, symbol or ordering changed.
notes: Both denials, the Future inside the second, and the top-level projection of the definite "I" and "this request" outside the strength-0 bundles are correct and untouched.
